title: taxillus microlimhus
intro: Taxillus microlimhus, commonly known as Loranthus micranthus, is a parasitic plant species that belongs to the family Loranthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and alleviating coughs. The therapeutic actions of Taxillus microlimhus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
